context:
Goal: the page never shows a missing-id notice again (your comment at 16:00 CST: "how is this id field bug still there").
Problem (rule): the fix is built but sits as a draft, and the freeze lets a new lane start only with your word for this item.
Based on (ruling): your 13:06 CST freeze: no new sessions, and new lanes only for items that land on main.
Based on (read): the id-from-key fix has been an open draft since Nov 6, 14:05 CST, 3,333 commits behind main, in no batch.
Based on (measured): triage wrote 7 items with no id today, and each showed the notice until 16:09 CST.
Departs from: main (each page reader takes the id from a field inside the item) — every reader takes it from the stored key, so an item with no id field still shows.
Meanwhile: triage keeps adding the id field by hand to each item it writes.

options.gain: The notice stops on every page, whoever writes the item.
options.how: A builder merges main into the id fix, a fresh reviewer reads it, and the coordinator puts it in the next batch.
options.label: Yes, one lane lands it (Recommended)
options.lose: One more lane runs during the freeze.

options.gain: No new lane during the freeze.
options.how: The fix stays a draft; triage adds the id by hand.
options.label: No, wait until the freeze lifts
options.lose: A missed id still shows the notice until the freeze lifts.

ref: owner page comment 16:00 CST Nov 10; coordinator 16:06 CST
reply: You picked a in chat at 16:15 CST (relayed by the coordinator). A builder started at 16:17 CST: it merges main into the id-from-key fix. Then a fresh reviewer reads it, and the batch runner puts it in the next batch. Step page-item-id-check tracks it. (Triage, 16:18 CST.)
short: Land the id fix in the freeze?
title: May triage start one lane now to land the built id-from-key fix, so the missing-id notice stops?
why: The fix is already built, so one short lane ends a bug you keep seeing.
